Today we’re introducing Devin for Security: a set of workflows for reducing security debt, securing every release, and accelerating response
recent_posts.summary: Cognition is launching Devin for Security, a set of AI-powered workflows aimed at reducing security debt, securing releases, and accelerating incident response. The announcement highlights that AI has dramatically shortened the time-to-exploit for attackers, while defensive tooling has lagged behind, framing security remediation as fundamentally an engineering capacity problem.

recent_posts.summary: Devin, the AI coding assistant, now integrates directly into your shell environment. By pressing Ctrl+G, Devin can see your current terminal context and provide instant help. The feature is set up via the command `devin shell setup`.

recent_posts.title:
Evinova, a separate health tech company within the AstraZeneca group, builds software that modern clinical trials run on.

They put Devin to work on regulatory documentation, bug triage, tech stack migrations, and test automation. 

One striking result: Devin produces documentation for regulators ~8x faster than the 35-40 hours it used to take across teams.
recent_posts.summary: Evinova, AstraZeneca's health tech subsidiary, deployed Devin (an AI software agent) across several engineering workflows including regulatory documentation, bug triage, tech stack migrations, and test automation. A standout outcome: regulatory documentation that previously took 35-40 hours across teams is now produced roughly 8x faster with Devin.
